limitations: Jam toko di Komachi, restoran, dan toko suvenir belum dipilih/diverifikasi.
Perempatan di Hachimangu, depan sekolah di pantai, dan menara jam Fujisawa belum punya titik tepat.
Lokasi makan siang dan malam tetap belum diketahui; jangan menggantinya diam-diam dengan restoran atau stasiun.
Rute ke titik referensi Oiwayamichi tidak mewakili seluruh panjang jalan atau antrean.

Tidak memaksa optimalitas atau kelayakan lengkap.

repair.instruction: Repair actual opening/date conflicts and insufficient travel allocations using this simulation. Its times already propagate earlier waits/travel. Keep every destination and required mode/pair, include system buffers, and return on the trip date. Visit durations in this untimed case remain explicit AI proposals. If a source is missing, preserve unknown rather than inventing proof. A clock change cannot fix a closed event season or an unknown restaurant identity.
